name: Umesh Deepak Waghmare
title: Full Stack .NET Developer | Angular | Azure | REST APIs
summary: 6+ years designing and developing enterprise-grade web applications using .NET Core, C#, Angular, TypeScript, and SQL Server — with strong expertise in Azure, microservices, and AI-enabled integrations.
careerNarrative: My career began as a Software Developer Trainee at Ixia Solutions, building student management systems with AngularJS and ASP.NET Core. I progressed through roles at Fincuro, Extentia, and Anthology — delivering flight booking platforms, automotive portals, and large-scale university management systems. Today at Pepper Advantage, I work as a Full Stack Developer on enterprise loan processing and AI-powered platforms, owning end-to-end delivery across Dev, UAT, and Production environments.
